measures.what: overall diameter across the board edge
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two mounting holes near the centre: diameter of each hole, and centre-to-centre distance between them
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: board thickness, and distance from the centre of the board to the centre of each mounting hole (or the hole positions relative to the centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: overall length and width of the board, and the spacing between the centres of its four corner holes (both directions)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: distance from the centre of the USB-C port mouth to the perfboard's long edge nearest it, and the height of the USB-C port opening (its short dimension) and width (long dimension)
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: where the 4-pin input connector and wires leave the disc: distance from the centre of the board to the connector, and the connector's width and height
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: height of the centre of the USB-C port opening above the perfboard's top face
measures.reply: esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: plug body size: the charger's length along the plug direction, its width and thickness, and the width/height of the USB-C plug tip
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.what: head diameter and shank diameter of the two screws the box will hang on, and their centre-to-centre spacing on the wall
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: thickness of the LED disc board, and the height of the tallest component on the LED side (if any)
measures.reply: led disk thickness: I can't measure that
